images.notes: Nuxt Image with IPX provider: /_ipx/f_{format}&s_{w}x{h}/path. Images have data-nuxt-img attribute.

animations.notes: Nuxt uses Vue transition classes: page-enter-active, page-leave-active. Same in Nuxt 2/3/4.

quirks.description: Vue scoped styles add data-v-* attributes to elements. These are not meaningful for migration.
quirks.workaround: Strip attributes matching /data-v-[a-f0-9]+/ from section labels.

quirks.description: Nuxt SSR pages have content in initial HTML. data-server-rendered is Nuxt 2 only; Nuxt 3/4 uses data-ssr attribute on __NUXT_DATA__ script.
quirks.workaround: Extract from SSR HTML for content. Wait for hydration before extracting interactive component styles.

quirks.description: <ClientOnly> components are missing from initial server-rendered HTML. Nuxt 4 may use comment placeholders instead of empty divs.
quirks.workaround: Wait for page load event + idle before extracting. Check for empty placeholders that fill in after hydration.

quirks.description: window.__NUXT__ is deleted after hydration in Nuxt 4 (and late Nuxt 3). The jsMarker !!window.__NUXT__ may return false if evaluated after hydration.
quirks.workaround: Use document.querySelector('[data-nuxt-data]') or script#__NUXT_DATA__ for reliable detection. The DOM element persists.

quirks.description: Sites using @nuxt/image with IPX serve images from /_ipx/ (self-hosted) or ipx.nuxt.com (hosted). Format: /_ipx/f_{format}&s_{w}x{h}/path. Images have data-nuxt-img attribute.
quirks.workaround: Match /_ipx/ and ipx.nuxt.com in cdnPatterns. Strip IPX transform prefix to get original image path.

quirks.description: SSR pages reference /_payload.json?{buildId} in data-src of __NUXT_DATA__ script. BuildId changes per deployment.
quirks.workaround: Do not rely on buildId in URLs for stable references.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
